main_strengths: All identified findings are correctly localized with valid, faithful interview quotations.

overall_evaluation_summary.benchmark_interpretation: This run has perfect segment-level detection at the recommended threshold and strong mechanism-level instance performance, but it underdetects one hidden instance and shows one taxonomy mismatch. The difference between mechanism-first and strict scores quantifies the cost of the Halo Effect versus Authority Bias label choice.
